editorial: When a suburban oasis turns into a cage of dread, you instantly feel its oppressive atmosphere. Unlike conventional thrillers, the film adopts a claustrophobic pacing that rattles from one scene to the next. A single, quietly delivered line from the relentless child actor turns an everyday home into a labyrinth of terror. You will enjoy the relentless tension if you thrive on slow-burning dread and perpetual uncertainty. The finale skims too quickly across the suspense, leaving you craving a more satisfying payoff.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
